categories.name: Playable Character Roster
categories.description: Unlock all 8 mid-boss rivals, the final boss Heihachi Mishima, and alternate costume Devil Kazuya (17 characters total).

categories.name: Arcade Story Campaigns
categories.description: Complete Arcade mode without character switching on Medium difficulty or higher across all 17 fighters.

categories.name: Combos & Technical Execution
categories.description: Execute universal 3-hit and 10-hit combinations, along with character-specific 6-hit combos for all 17 fighters.

categories.name: Difficulty & Endurance Trials
categories.description: Finish Arcade mode on Hard, Ultra Hard, under 5 minutes (speedrun), and a grueling 5-round marathon without continues.

playthrough_notes: Tekken (PS1) is a 3D fighting game where 100% completion requires completing individual Arcade mode campaigns across all characters, practicing combos in Versus Mode or Arcade Mode, clearing the Galaga loading mini-game, and tackling specific difficulty/endurance parameters. No achievements are permanently missable or mutually exclusive, as individual Arcade runs and VS Mode matches can be attempted at any time. Emulator caveats reported by players: Long Journey and some combo achievements may fail to trigger on DuckStation; RetroArch with Beetle PSX or PCSX ReArmed worked (ra-comments-80-3, ra-comments-4-4).
settings_notes: Default settings: Difficulty Medium, Round Count 3, Round Time 40. The per-character Arcade achievements only require Medium or higher without changing characters, so Hard with 1 round is allowed and recommended (ra-comments-3-4, ra-comments-4-9). Hand-to-Hand Veteran (90423, Hard or higher) and Hand-to-Hand Expert (90422, Ultra Hard) require default settings; check the round timer is 40, not infinite (ra-comments-76-3). Do a separate Hard run for 90423: one player reports an Ultra Hard run did not award both (ra-comments-76-4). Long Journey (90429) needs Round Count 5 and otherwise default settings (ra-comments-79-3).

chapters.title: Boot Challenge & Core Combat Fundamentals
chapters.notes: Clear all 8 Galaga stages with a perfect using at most ONE continue for the entire run (the old unlimited-continue tip is outdated after a logic change); earn the double ship by clearing stage 1 in under 18.5 seconds (the controller-2 trick does not count). Then establish basic controls, earn a Perfect round, and perform the 3-hit and 10-hit combos; the 10-hit is unreliable and character/emulator dependent (Michelle in 2P mode is the most reported working method).

chapters.title: The Original Eight: Base Roster Campaigns & Sub-Boss Unlocks
chapters.notes: Clear Arcade mode with each of the 8 base fighters on Medium or higher without changing characters (Hard with 1 round recommended), defeating their Stage 8 rivals to unlock the sub-bosses. Earn each character's 6-hit combo achievement IN ARCADE MODE (players report 6-hit achievements do not unlock in 2P/VS mode); for most characters pressing the same punch button 6 times works, otherwise use the 10-attack string.

chapters.title: The Sub-Boss Uprising & Full Roster Completion
chapters.notes: Clear Arcade mode with each of the 8 unlocked sub-bosses on Medium or higher without changing characters (Hard, 1 round recommended) and earn their 6-hit combos in Arcade mode (Kunimitsu has no 10 string: use the Yoshimitsu-style 7-hit string). Unlock Heihachi to complete the roster: players report he unlocks after a no-continue Arcade clear with one of the 8 starting characters (one report: under 5:30).

chapters.title: The Mishima Zaibatsu: Heihachi Campaign & Mastery
chapters.notes: Select Heihachi and clear Arcade mode on Medium or higher without changing characters (may need a second clear before it pops). Heihachi's 6-hit: dash, hold the second forward ~1-1.5s, then Triangle and the 10-attack string; to avoid the aggressive AI, lose on purpose with another character and switch to Heihachi via character select on lose.

chapters.title: Master of the Iron Fist: Hard, Speedrun & Marathon Trials
chapters.notes: Specialty runs with default settings: Hard (90423) and Ultra Hard (90422) as separate runs (Ultra Hard is reported easier than Medium; continues are allowed), the sub-5-minute run (90427; Lee d+4,4,4, Michelle or King 10-hit, Ganryu throw-stomp), and Long Journey (90429; Round Count 5, no continues, no character change; prefer RetroArch over DuckStation).
